goal: Prevent seednodes and address fetches from being discarded while network activity is disabled
Allow nodes to bootstrap outbound connections after re-enabling network activity without restarting
agreement: No reviews or substantive comments yet

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it stops seednode queues from being silently exhausted while networking is toggled off
Ensures nodes can still discover peers after networking is re-enabled without requiring a node restart
